title: Mem Saheb
desc: Kajal falls in love with Amit, an unemployed journalist. She urges him to focus on his career and provides unconditional support, but destiny has other plans for the couple.

title: Praner Cheye Priyo
desc: A couple's life falls to ruin when Chaiti, a sinister woman, marries into their family and wreaks havoc among them.

title: Rupban
desc: A 12-year-old Rupban is married to Rahim when he is just 12 days old. However, their lives take a turn when Rahim grows older, only to refuse to accept Rupban as his wife and fall in love with Tajel.

title: Matir Manush
desc: After Meeting With An Accident, Payel Falls In Love With A Man. Things Turn When Her Father Disapproves Of Their Relationship.

title: Satru Mitra
desc: A happy family goes through various trials and tribulations and falls apart when greed takes precedence over relationships.

title: Damu
desc: Damu, an orphan, befriends Runku and promises her an elephant ride around the village. However, he faces many challenges trying to find an elephant.

title: Sanjhbati
desc: An elderly woman struggles with her difficult nature and isolated life. When a new caretaker arrives, their relationship faces challenges, developing into a story about connection and companionship.

title: Ajob Premer Golpo
desc: Dipto, a cheerful young man, falls in love with Sulgana, who is much older than him. However, things escalate when their families object to their relationship because of their age gap.

title: Patanjali Yog - By Yogrishi Swami Ramdev
desc: Baba Ramdev emphasises the importance of yoga and demonstrates various asanas and breathing exercises that enable one to lead a healthy and stress-free life.

title: Biye Bibhraat
desc: After a series of unsuccessful relationships, Shakya reluctantly consents to meet a prospective bride. However, things take an unexpected twist when the girl's former lover reenters the picture.

title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Abhimaan
desc: After disowning his daughter years ago, an elderly businessman now seeks the help of his grandson to mend his relationship with her.

title: Baba Keno Chakar
desc: When Rajnarayan asks his son to help out with the expenses for his sister's wedding, he refuses. As a result, he is forced to go from pillar to post to make ends meet.

title: Kamalar Banabas
desc: Banished from the kingdom under false pretences, Kamala endures hardship while raising her son, determined to clear her name and reunite with her loved ones.

title: Handa and Bhonda
desc: The spirit of a man's late wife grants the wishes of her husband and her son for seven days in hopes that they find common ground with one another.

title: Kalankini Badhu
desc: Soumik leaves his family when his brothers are contemptuous about his inability to find a job. However, his continued absence begins to tear the family apart.
